n. 环, 环形物, 体环
[化] 环形缝; 环隙

annulus migrans linguae.translation: [医] 地图样舌, 脱屑性局限性舌炎

annunciable.definition: a. That may be announced or declared; declarable.

annunciates.translation: v. 宣告, 宣布( annunciate的第三人称单数 ); 表明即将到来[就绪]

annunciating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Annunciate

annunciation.definition:
n. a festival commemorating the announcement of the Incarnation by the angel Gabriel to the Virgin Mary; a quarter day in England, Wales, and Ireland
n. (Christianity) the announcement to the Virgin Mary by the angel Gabriel of the incarnation of Christ

annunciation day.translation: 【基督教】圣母领报节(3月25日)[亦作 Lady Day,the Annunciation]

annunciator.definition: n. an indicator that announces which electrical circuit has been active (as on a telephone switchboard)
annunciator.translation:
n. 通报者, 信号器
[化] 报讯器

annunciatory.definition: a relating to the act of announcing or being announced
annunciatory.translation: a. 可预告作用的, 预告的

annus mirabilis.translation: <拉>奇迹迭出的一年, 令人惊异之年

annwn.translation: [网络] 安温；即因安温；亚朗
